1.Title: Hatching Day
1.Description: The equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>90</color>. When Anomaly DMG dealt by any squad member to an enemy triggers a critical hit, the equipper's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
